title: Elon Musk: AI, robots, and abundance

predictions.headline: AI smarter than any single human
predictions.detail: Prediction: AI surpasses the intelligence of any individual human by 2026–2027.
predictions.sourceNote: Paraphrased from a compiled list of public statements; the source gives 2026–2027, placed at the later year.

predictions.headline: Superhuman AI for any digital work
predictions.detail: Prediction: by the end of 2027, AI can do anything digital that does not require shaping atoms, at a superhuman level.
predictions.sourceNote: Paraphrased from a compiled list of public statements.

predictions.headline: Humans can't compete at software engineering
predictions.detail: Prediction: AI reaches a point in software engineering where humans simply can't compete.
predictions.sourceNote: Undated in the source list; placed with the end-of-2027 digital-work claim.

predictions.headline: Optimus out-operates the best surgeons
predictions.detail: Prediction: the Optimus humanoid robot becomes a better surgeon than the world's best human surgeons, roughly within three years.
predictions.sourceNote: Source says roughly three years; placed at 2029.

predictions.headline: AI smarter than all humanity combined
predictions.detail: Prediction: AI surpasses the combined intelligence of all humanity around 2030–2031.
predictions.sourceNote: Source gives 2030–2031, placed at the later year.

predictions.headline: A billion humanoid robots at work
predictions.detail: Prediction: at least one billion humanoid robots exist within ten years, each producing roughly five times the output of a human, together more productive than all humans combined.
predictions.sourceNote: Source says within ten years; placed at 2036.

predictions.headline: AI and robots double the world economy
predictions.detail: Prediction: AI and robots more than double the global economy in less than ten years.
predictions.sourceNote: Source says less than ten years; placed at 2036.

predictions.headline: Universal high income, work optional
predictions.detail: Prediction: AI and robots lead to universal high income, and work becomes optional.
predictions.sourceNote: Framed in the source as the coming decade; placed with the ten-year robot and economy claims.

predictions.headline: Work becomes a choice, not survival
predictions.detail: Prediction: work shifts from something people need to do to survive economically into something they choose to do.
predictions.sourceNote: Undated in the source list; placed with the universal-high-income claim.

predictions.headline: Saving for retirement stops mattering
predictions.detail: Prediction: if AI-driven abundance develops as predicted, saving for retirement eventually becomes irrelevant.
predictions.sourceNote: Conditional and undated in the source list; placed with the universal-high-income claim.

predictions.headline: An age of extraordinary abundance
predictions.detail: Prediction: the long-term outcome is an age of extraordinary abundance driven by AI, robotics, and abundant energy.
predictions.sourceNote: Long-term and undated in the source list; placed at the last year the game's calendar covers.
